# noozle_query_outlet_link (Data Source)

Reads one query-to-outlet association for a pre-existing Noozle outlet.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `outlet_id` (Number) Identifier of the outlet.
- `query_id` (Number) Identifier of the linked query.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in `<outlet_id>:<query_id>` format.
